The '''Ay'Nat''' were a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that operated in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> They were also present at some point in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatooine system]] where they conflicted with [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]].<ref name="SWG:Runaways" /> In space battles, the Ay'Nat pirates flied [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]]s, [[Rihkxyrk assault fighter]]s, [[Ixiyen-class fast attack craft|''Ixiyen''-class fast attack crafts]], [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]],<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> and [[AEG-77 Vigo]].<ref name="SWG:Runaways" />

==History==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Dulios]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaydine]] of the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]] hired [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to attack the Ay'Nat.<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

Around the same time, they assigned an AEG-77 Vigo and an escort of X-wing starfighters to exfiltrate [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] fugitive droid [[LIN-34]] from the Tatooine system. However, the mission failed and all ships were destroyed by Jabba's pilots.<ref name="SWG:Runaways" />
